zh.title: 雪梨第二座國際機場啟用：耗資56億澳元、全天候營運
zh.summary: 耗資56億澳元的雪梨西部國際機場於10月25日星期日開始接待旅客，總理艾班尼斯稱這是澳洲50多年來首座啟用的大型新機場。機場位於雪梨以西約60公里，全天候營運，年客運量可逾8000萬人次，捷星航空執飛首班出境航班前往黃金海岸。
body: 耗資56億澳元的雪梨新機場於10月25日星期日開始接待旅客，結束逾10年的規劃。機場名為雪梨西部國際機場，位於雪梨以西約60公里的Badgerys Creek，全天候營運，可服務快速成長且族裔多元的人口中心。澳洲總理Anthony Albanese表示，澳洲50多年來首次啟用大型新機場，是醞釀數十年的里程碑，他很自豪能正式啟用機場。
現有機場僅能在晚間11時前與清晨6時後起降，限制了航空公司的排班彈性；相較之下，新機場24小時營運。捷星航空預定於星期日執飛首班出境航班前往黃金海岸；機場年客運量可逾8000萬人次。客運服務啟動前，貨運航班已於7月開始營運。機場占地1780公頃，土地由聯邦政府於1980年代購入，歷經15年規劃、7年興建，於2025年7月完工。

en.title: Sydney's new international airport opens to passengers
en.summary: Sydney's new A$5.6 billion airport opened to passengers on Sunday after more than a decade of planning, with 24-hour operations and capacity for more than 80 million passenger movements a year.
body: Sydney's new A$5.6 billion ($3.94 billion) airport opened to passengers on Sunday after more than a decade of planning, in what Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said was a milestone for the country's most populous city. The new Western Sydney International Airport in Badgerys Creek, about 60 km (37.3 miles) west of central Sydney, will operate 24 hours a day, giving airlines access to a fast-growing and ethnically diverse population centre.

The current airport, located closer to Sydney's central business district, can host takeoffs and landings only until 11 p.m. and after 6 a.m., limiting airline scheduling options relative to other major Australian cities like Melbourne. Albanese said: “For the first time in more than 50 years, Australia is opening a major new airport. It’s a milestone that has been decades in the making,” and added: “I’m very proud to officially open it.”

Qantas' budget arm Jetstar was due to operate the first outbound flight to the Gold Coast on Sunday, the airport said in a statement. The airport has capacity for more than 80 million passenger movements annually, it said. The start of passenger services comes after cargo flights commenced at the facility in July. Located on a 1,780-hectare (4,398-acre) site purchased by the federal government in the 1980s, the airport was completed in July 2025 after a seven-year build and 15 years of planning.
